create_UpdateOtherFieldHook: create an UpdateOtherFieldHook that sets another field on a dataclass instance when a field changes
build_UpdateOtherFieldHook_with_conditio: build an UpdateOtherFieldHook with a custom update_condition callable to control when the hook fires
use_UpdateOtherFieldHook_triggers: use an UpdateOtherFieldHook with custom HookEventType triggers to run on specific lifecycle events
review_UpdateOtherFieldHook_only_trigger: review an UpdateOtherFieldHook configured with only_trigger_on_change to run unconditionally on every event
refactor_UpdateOtherFieldHook_update_fun: refactor an UpdateOtherFieldHook to use a different update_function callable for computing the other field value
